Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3

Class PlanTypeDimension

java.lang.Object
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.PlanTypeDimension
public class PlanTypeDimension extends Object
Maps a single dimension entry as returned by the REST API's plan-type-scoped dimension list endpoint (GET applications/{app}/plantypes/{cube}/dimensions). Unlike the older, unofficial data management (DM/AIF) dimension listing, this endpoint identifies attribute dimensions directly via getDimType() and requires no special privileges.

    • isValid

      public boolean isValid()
      Whether this dimension is currently valid/consistent in the outline.

      Only a response that says "valid": false makes a dimension invalid. The endpoint on current pods leaves the field out altogether, and a dimension it lists without comment is taken as valid rather than rejected.

      Returns:
      false if the server reported the dimension invalid, true otherwise

    • setValid
